interpretation: Breaks the clean 'own scenario collapses, other scenario mild' pattern seen with aspirin (RGU) and rosiglitazone (IFE). HRT is an RGU-scenario concept, but its own scenario (RGU) shows FA DECREASING (0.741->0.707, opposite direction from aspirin's own-RGU increase) with DEF/EWEF also dropping. The other scenario (IFE, untargeted) shows FA rising more (0.839->0.911) while DEF/EWEF stay close to baseline (no collapse, unlike aspirin's IFE-collapse-to-0). Combined with the second non-perfect Restricted-CLMI (0.994) seen for this concept, this is a real, substantial, concept-dependent effect on both scenarios, but the DIRECTION and WHICH scenario collapses is not consistent across concepts -- reporting honestly rather than forcing a clean narrative. Underscores that per-concept variance is real and a single concept's result (as in the original aspirin write-up) should not be treated as fully representative; needs aggregation across concepts once more are tested, and ultimately statistical treatment (seeds, variance) before any claim about 'the' OGDA effect.
